# /crav1-suggest-tests-for-code

lane: cross-cutting | group: Testing helpers | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.17.0 | prompts: 1
purpose: The user points at code that already exists, one repo or one area, not the whole system.
use_when: The user points at existing code
reads: Reads one repo or one area of code that already exists, the tests with that code, and the existing spec.
writes: Writes nothing itself.
leaves alone: Leaves tests, application code, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md` alone.
limits: the whole system, no code pointed at, or no existing spec stops with no list. Leave writes nothing and is offered again. Dismiss is not offered again. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. Plan turns a kept suggestion into a task. It is not a starter option.
flow:
- When the user points at code that already exists, one repo or one area, **`/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code`** reads that code and suggests tests for what that code can actually break.
- The user takes them one at a time: keep, leave, or dismiss.
- A kept suggestion goes onto the existing spec through `/crav1-add-to-spec`.
- A kept suggestion goes onto the existing spec through `/crav1-add-to-spec`.
- a kept suggestion opens `../crav1-add-to-spec/references/handoffs-suggest-tests.md` and does not start `/crav1-add-to-spec`.
- The rule is `docs/reference/open-skill-file.md`.
- One card for every suggestion prints a findings table in that same reply before the card.
- The card names each item and its recommendation.
- It does not say `table above`.
- The card is not asked without the table.
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Opens `/crav1-add-to-spec` for one kept suggestion and for one dismissed suggestion, and does not start that command.
you run next: /crav1-plan-from-spec
first: `/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code @<one repo or one area> @docs/specs/<slug>/ Suggest tests for what this code can break. Do not write the tests. Do not change the code.`
walkthrough: from-suggest-tests.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.204.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-suggest-tests-for-code.md
